channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Biden | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Biden from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Craig Hodges on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
Whether it’s Trump or Biden, Obama or Bush, Hodges believes the real decision-makers wear tailored suits on Wall Street — not the White House.

“To me, Trump and Biden? It’s a uniparty. Two wings of the same bird,”

Craig Hodges on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, May 13, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Joe Biden
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I don't want to be pessimistic, but I think now having a new face (Biden), people are taking their foot off the gas, thinking that everything is ok now. I would like to challenge that. We still have a lot of work to do, regardless if Biden is in office or not.”

Jaylen Brown on Joe Biden, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Devin Vassell on Joe Biden
item.description:
Spurs rookie Devin Vassell on Joe Biden taking office:

“It’s big for the country, for change, and just to know we have somebody in the office that is going to care about unity and all cultures and bring some awareness to social injustice and really to just help us all out.”

Devin Vassell on Joe Biden, Jan 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Joe Biden, Kamala Harris
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Doc Rivers:

“This country needs healing. I hope that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris can do it, because we need it.”

Doc Rivers on Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, Jan 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
Gregg Popovich:

“Now it's time for you to decide where you stand. For me it's pretty simple: a vote for Donald Trump is a vote against the very ideals upon which our democracy was founded. Our democracy is at stake, so please stand with me, united in the land of the free and the home of the brave. I stand with Joe Biden.”

Gregg Popovich on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, Oct 29, 2020. Source: Kens5.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Joe Biden
item.description:
“In a three-way between me, Biden and Trump, I dominated the independent vote — I got like 77 percent percent of it and was able to take some votes away from Donald and some votes away from Biden. But in aggregate, I was only able to get up to 25 percent. From every which way, crosstab, you name it, I had it analyzed and scrutinized every which way, projected, and they could only see me getting up to 25 percent. That’s why I didn’t pursue it further.”

Mark Cuban on Donald Trump, Joe Biden, Jun 4, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.
